name: Ginpatsu Gyaru
source: A shop assistant at MGSM, a fashionable clothing store in the local mall. Often called Gin-chan. Kouhai of [url=/c119223]Kinugawa Kaede[/url]. Always speaks in keigo. Likes kicking in the balls. Low voice. Hates riajuu. Younger than [url=/c119221]Akino Yasuo[/url].
